remoteTelemetryTooltip: Helps with issue tracking and debugging, recommended to enable
cloudflareApiTokenTooltip:
When set, backend operations like blocking and deleting won't be affected by CDN cache
Recommended, see documentation for setup
randomImageApiTooltip: See documentation for API usage details
directoryTooltip:
1. Directories with random image access, defaults to root. Separate multiple directories with commas
2. All directories use absolute paths, e.g. /img/cover, meaning files in this directory and all subdirectories can be accessed by the random image API
publicBrowseTooltip: When enabled, visitors can browse images in specified directories via /browse path (read-only, no delete/move)
openDirectoryTooltip:
Directories open for public browsing, separate multiple with commas

Example: wallpaper,photos,album

Supports subdirectories: 2026/lucky,2026/rich

Access URL: https://your.domain/browse/2026/lucky
webdavTooltip: When enabled, images can be accessed and managed via WebDAV protocol
